user.title: Configure Chameleon
user.description: Set up Chameleon to apply image colors to your lights. Select multiple lights to distribute colors from the image palette across them.

data_description.light_entities: The RGB lights to control with scene colors. Each light will receive a unique color from the image palette.
data_description.transition: Fade duration in seconds between colors. Set to 0 to disable animation (static scenes only).
data_description.media_player_entity: Optional media player whose current album artwork is used by the Album Art effect.
data_description.normalize_brightness: Adjust extracted RGB colors for bright, vibrant LED output. This does not change the light brightness setting.
data_description.randomize_color_assignment: When Random is selected, shuffle which configured light receives each palette color. Named scenes keep their usual order.

abort.already_configured: These lights are already configured with Chameleon

init.title: Configure Chameleon
init.description: Choose an optional album-art source and how extracted colors appear on LEDs.

data_description.media_player_entity: Artwork changes update the configured Chameleon lights only while the Album Art effect is active.
data_description.normalize_brightness: Change extracted RGB values to bright, vibrant colors with a similar output level. The Home Assistant brightness slider is unchanged.
data_description.randomize_color_assignment: Shuffle palette colors across the configured lights each time Random is selected. Named scenes and Album Art keep their original order.
